Subject: Quick — competitive rate check for NimbleHealth renewal

Marissa / Karthik,

NimbleHealth (RDW-2319) just surfaced competitor numbers in prep for procurement next week. Procurement asked whether we can provide a matched hosted-API offer or a tiered reserved option — they specifically called out OpenAI and AWS Bedrock. Can you pull together:

- a terse comparison table (OpenAI / Anthropic / Together / AWS) for hosted per-token + embeddings, and where their committed discounts kick in
- suggested Redwood counter (hosted pricing and a 12/24-month committed tier)
- clear ask for what Nimble would need to commit to to get parity (MM tokens / $ committed / minimum term)

No need for polished deck — bullet points and sources are fine. They want numbers by EOD Monday.

Attaching a blank competitor template I used last quarter — paste your numbers in and send back.

Thanks,
Rafael
Head of GTM — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick — competitive rate check for NimbleHealth renewal

Rafael —

Compiled the initial numbers and annotated assumptions (see attached). Key takeaways:

- OpenAI (hosted): roughly $35 / 1M prompt+completion tokens for their advanced chat models at enterprise rate; embeddings ~ $12 / 1M vectors at current published enterprise tier. 12-month committed discounts reported in market are ~10–18% depending on volume and support.
- Anthropic (hosted): list pricing slightly higher for chat; they often price embeddings and chat separately — expect enterprise tiers at ~12–20% discount on a 12–24 month commit.
- Together: competitive on bulk-only deals, frequently requires larger minimums to unlock sub-$30/1M token equivalents.
- AWS Bedrock: pricing varies by model partner; Bedrock’s advantage is consolidated infra + marketplace discounts, but network+egress can push total cost higher for heavy token use.

Assumptions included in the sheet: net effective price = list * marketplace discount; embeddings unit aligned to 1M vectors, tokens scaled to our internal tokenization. I flagged where published vendor T&Cs require minimum committed spend or reserved capacity.

Attached: competitor_rates_q2_2027.xlsx (tabbed by vendor).

Marissa
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: competitor_rates_q2_2027.xlsx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick — competitive rate check for NimbleHealth renewal

Adding capacity / reserved notes — pulled from past Dedicated deals and partner marketplace docs:

- Reserved / dedicated pricing (AWS/Together analogs): discounts only meaningful above committed GPU-month equivalents; typical thresholds are $30k–$100k/month to reach single-digit per-1k-token effective costs.
- For Redwood Dedicated: we can structure a 12-month reserved pool starting at $25k/month that gives a 15% off hosted-rate-equivalent for sustained throughput, plus guaranteed latency SLOs. For 24-month terms we can push to ~22% off list.
- Embeddings: because embeddings seating is more memory-bound, dedicated pools yield smaller marginal savings unless quantized/accelerator-specific.

I’m attaching the committed-tier PDF I use to align finance + engineering on what we can promise on throughput/SLOs.

Karthik
Director, Dedicated Solutions — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: dedicated_commitment_tiers.pdf]

- Dedicated path: $25k/month reserved pool, guaranteed throughput and predictable latency. Pricing below hosted list once utilization > 65%.

Action items for procurement:

- If procurement prefers dedicated, tell us target monthly committed spend and 12 vs 24-month preference.

We’re happy to jump on a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk numbers.

Rafael

Next steps:
1) If you want the hosted parity line, confirm the $60k/mo target and I’ll circulate a short term sheet + DocuSign link by EOD Friday.

I’ll loop in legal + finance once you confirm. Happy to take a short call to walk the SLAs.
